ABOUT THE AUTHOR Hajee Mahboob Kassim [d 12 Ramadan 1421 A.H. / 9 Dec 2000] was born on Friday 26th March 1920 (5th Rajjab 1338 A.H.). This date fell during the annual Urs or Remembrance Days of His Holiness Khwaja Syedna Moinuddin Hasan Chishti (R.A.) of Ajmer (d 633 A.H. / 1234 A.D.), the Patron Saint of the Indian subcontinent. From his very childhood he was always under the spiritual influence of this great Saint. The very mention of the name of this Saint immediately had very great effect upon him. As such he always had a very great leaning towards spiritualism and love for the distressed mankind. From the age of seven he kept all the Ramadan fasts and loved to perform the five times daily prayers. At the age of about 40 years by the Islamic calendar, he accidentally met a Chishti Saint, Khwaja Hajee Syed Musharafali Chishti, at Cuttack. He accepted him as his spiritual guide in March 1958. Six weeks later, Khwaja Musharafali introduced him to his spiritual guide, His Holiness Khwaja Diwan Syed Enayat Hussain Ali Khan Moini Chishti Tausi, a descendant of the Saint of Ajmer, who ordained Mahboob Kassim in 1958 as the Khalifa or "Spiritual Master" of the following Sufi schools:
1. Chishti Nizami Tausi 2. Qadri Razaki Barkati 3. Chishti Sabari Mujaddadi 4. Saharwardi 5. Naqshbandi
Upon his ordination he was ordered to compile researches that would be beneficial for mankind. Some of the researches are:

1. Destruction or Peace (1971) 2. God Said : Let There Be Light - Oh Light ! Guide Us (1985) 3. Musharaf-ul-Mahboobin (1985 in Urdu) 4. Muhammad in World Scriptures (1989 in English & Urdu) 5. "Talaq, Talaq, Talaq" In the light of the Qur’an & Hadis (1992 in Urdu)

Hajee Mahboob Kassim was a great philanthropist and a reputed leader of the Islamic world. He was Founder-member and President of several not-for-profit trusts and social welfare organizations. He established the Khanqah Qadriya Chishtiya Musharrafiya and the Institute for Sufi Researches in Calcutta. To

this day, the Khanqah serves as a house for worship of Allah Subhaanahu wa Ta'ala and as an active center for helping the poor, needy and ill people of Calcutta, who are given free therapy, treatment and medicines every morning – a practice which is kept alive until today by his devoted disciples.

Professionally, he was a shipping expert. He was the first Indian to be made Fellow of the Institute of Chartered Shipbrokers, London; Fellow of the Royal Institute of Arbitrators, London; Commissioner for the Port of Calcutta; Member-Secretary, Transport, Federation of Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (FICCI); founder of the Haldia Anchorage Subsidiary Port Scheme; representative of major maritime companies in worldwide arbitration; and Lecturer on Shipping Law and Practice at Narottam Morarjee Institute of Shipping at Calcutta; and ran his own Shipping & Chartering business.

Step by step, comma by comma, he followed in the footsteps of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (peace of Allah be upon him) and established perfect observance of all the Sunnah and Shariah of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (peace of Allah be upon him). His humility, his innate joyfulness and his dedication to prayer, to the needy, and to his family, endeared him to everyone who had the good fortune of meeting him.
This book has been published posthumously, five years after the departure of the author from earthly life.
In the words of Hajee Mahboob Kassim:
"The Good God, Almighty and Kind Make this a blessing for mankind." Insha'Allah, Ameen Thumma Ameen.
20 Royd Street, Kolkata – 700016 (India) November 2005

1. INTRODUCTION
When in Canada and U.S.A. several opportunities were afforded to the
author of this article to deliver lectures on various religious topics at
Friday sermons. One of them was on :

chapters.heading: Section 2
paragraphs: "Ah! What will convey to you what is Lailatul Qadar?"
"Lailatul Qadar is better than a thousand months of worship”.
This reference relates to the how Lailatul Qadar could be attained by an
ordinary person.
This makes it necessary to study the Holy Qur'an. Let us start with Sura
2 – Al Baqarah : Middle of Ayat 255 which confirms :
"...He (Allah) knows what is before them (humanity) and what is
behind them. They encompass nothing of His Knowledge except (to
that extent) what He pleases (to let humans know)..."
2. THE REVELATION OF FIRST FIVE VERSES OF QUR'AN – ITS IMPORTANCE TO EDUCATION
Allah is the source of all knowledge. The very first verses of the Qur'an
revealed on earth were during Lailatul Qadar (the night of Power) during
the night between Thursday and Friday called in Arabic "Shab-e-Juma"
or the night of Juma during the last part of month of Ramadan at Gar-e-
Hera (Cave of Research) on Jabl-e-Noor (the Mount of Light) just a few
AH ! WHAT WILL CONVEY TO YOU WHAT IS LAILATUL QADAR ?
Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
miles from Makkah to Muhammad (peace be on him) when he was forty
years old. He is the only Prophet who has been an "ummi" i.e. one whom
nobody could teach either to read or to write yet he taught the world
what they knew not. That is why "iqra" has been used by the Revealer
because He is the only Teacher of the Prophet. This revelation discloses
that our Creator is the Teacher of all. He teaches us by the pen as is
embodied in the opening 5 verses of the Qur'an in Sura 96 – Al Alaq :
Ayats 1-5 reading :
1. "Iqra (read O Prophet Muhammad) in the name of your Lord,
Who creates (everything).
2. "Creates human beings from a clot.
3. "Read : your Lord is Most Generous,
4. "Who teaches by the pen.
5. "Teaches (continuously) humanity what they knew not".
3. THE CREATOR TEACHES ILM-E-GAIB – KNOWLEDGE UNKNOWN TO US
The essence of these revelations may be summed up as :
"Read (O Prophet Muhammad) in the name of the Creator of the
universe, Who teaches by the pen to the people on earth what they knew
not" i.e. Ilm-e-gaib or knowledge which was unknown to the people. The
daily discoveries now being made by the will of Allah by scientists
become common knowledge once they are circulated in writing. Thus
bringing out that the Qur'an in the very opening sentences 1400 years
AH ! WHAT WILL CONVEY TO YOU WHAT IS LAILATUL QADAR ?
Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
back foretold that the Almighty is going to teach humanity "what they
knew not".
4. HOW WAS THE QUR'AN REVEALED
The Ilm-e-gaib taught to the world by the "Ummi Prophet" is the "Holy
Qur'an". This Divine Scripture is the last of the Revelations. The Qur'an
is protected by Allah. It overrides and completes all the earlier scriptures
as shown by the last sentence of the Qur'an revealed at Gadir-e-Khum on
18th Zil Haj 11 A.H. This was during the return journey from Makkah
after Haj-ul-Weda (the last Haj of the Prophet) in Sura 5 – Al Maidah : in
the middle of Ayat 3 which reads :
"...This day those who disbelieve are in despair of (ever being able to
harm) My religion blessed upon you (which was incomplete from the
very beginning till the time of prophet Esa – Jesus) and completed
My favours upon you and have chosen for you as religion AL
ISLAM..."
The Qur'an was revealed in small parts spread over a period of 23 years.
It comprised of the 114 Chapters (86 in Makkah over a period of 13 years
addressed to the disbelievers and the balance in 10 years at Madinah).
Some of the Madinah Suras were regarding Jews, Christians and
hypocrites as well as laws for humanity to adapt. That left only very few
Chapters addressed to believers containing the essence of Islam or the
real teachings of love and brotherhood. All these Ayats of the Qur'an were
revealed when the Prophet was in a state of trance. At such moments the

Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
Prophet uttered the revelations in a manner in which it was apparent
that he was not in his normal conditions but the words were being put
into his mouth by some supernatural external force i.e. Allah and he was
merely uttering them. These revelations of Allah took place whenever any
incident happened. These comprised of one or more verses of the Qur'an.
These Ayats were the answers to the problems facing the people. The

chapters.heading: Section 3
paragraphs: Prophet would also disclose at the same time that these verses would go
into such and such a position in such and such a Sura (Chapter of the
Qur'an). These were immediately noted with precision on whatever was
handy. Sometimes they were written on skins or shoulder bones of
animals etc. These scattered passages of the Qur'an were collected
shortly after the departure of the Prophet from earthly life. They fitted
into the super jigsaw puzzle without any confusion in spite of the fact
that there were over 6200 Ayats. The essence of the Qur'an is that the
Creator of the universe is only "One". There is no other god besides Him.
Idolatry was blasphemy, an unpardonable sin. Anyone praying before
imaginary idols of non existing gods would be condemned to Hell. This
raised the anger of disbelievers of Qureysh. They were the leading tribe at
Makkah. The vast majority of them in course of time had fallen from the
worship of the One Allah, as taught by Prophets Ibrahim (Abraham) and
Ismail, the builders of the Kaabah the house for worship of Allah, the
Alone. But the majority used to worship 360 idols at the time of the birth
of the Holy Prophet. The disbelievers of Makkah bitterly attacked the
Prophet daily. To prevent these attacks the 86 Suras were revealed at
Makkah. These concentrated mainly upon :

Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
i) "Fear of Hell" for the mischief makers
ii) Heaven with all kinds of luxuries including palaces, hurs, fruits all of
unimaginable wonders for those who do good. The number of believers
was a few hundreds.
As against that the teachings at Madinah were based upon love of Allah
and were addressed to the Muslims or those who wished to lead their
lives in surrender to the laws of love revealed by Allah. This won over a
million Arabs, making it clear which of the two teachings were more
important.
The later teachings of Madinah would naturally have an overriding effect
upon the Makkah Suras (in spite of their large numbers) because the
concluding Suras in Madinah contained the essence and the final
teachings of Allah.
5. REPEATED ATTEMPTS TO DESTROY & FORGE QUR'AN FAILED – GREATEST EXISTING MIRACLE OF THE PROPHET
The Qur'an is the greatest and ever lasting miracle of the Prophet in
which not a single flaw could be forged till date. 1400 years of effort to
produce even one small part matching those of the Qur'an has failed.
Repeated attempts were then made at destroying the Qur'an by burning
millions of copies in every city captured by the Crusaders and the Tatars.
But all these attempts tailed because the Qur'an was known by heart by
the Hafiz, who rewrote the Qur'an without any mistakes. Thereafter
AH ! WHAT WILL CONVEY TO YOU WHAT IS LAILATUL QADAR ?
Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
repeated attempts were made to introduce forgeries into the Qur'an. All
such repeated attempts failed because these forgeries were instantly
found out by the Hafiz and immediately corrected.
6. QUR'AN SAVES EUROPE FROM 800 YEARS OF DARK AGES
800 years of Dark Ages plagued the Europeans. It was at last the wisdom
of the Qur'an which was Ilm-e-gaib or knowledge unknown to them
which saved them as recorded by Chamber's Encyclopaedia on
"Civilisation of Europe".
"We cannot consider in this place", records Chambers' Encyclopaedia,
"what Islam has done for the cause of all humanity, or more exactly what
is its share in the development of science and art in Europe. Broadly
speaking, the Muhammadans may be said to have been the enlightened
teachers of barbarous Europe, from the ninth to the thirteenth
century.......
Arabic philosophy, medicine, natural history, geography, history,
grammar, rhetoric and the 'golden art of poetry', schooled by the old
Hellenic masters brought forth an abundant harvest of works, many of
which will live and teach as long as there will be generations to be
taught".
AH ! WHAT WILL CONVEY TO YOU WHAT IS LAILATUL QADAR ?
Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
Sura 6 – Al Anam in the middle of Ayat 59 informs :
"...And not (even) a leaf falls (from any tree) but with His (Allah's)
knowledge..."
So all progress amongst the Europeans and their settlers in America and
elsewhere have led to many new discoveries being made. All this
knowledge of the Almighty imparted to humanity led to the wonderful
achievements of today. These include medicines, cures, treatments,
computers, technology increased production, satellite communication,
landing on the moon and probes into the planets of Mercury, Venus,
Mars, the moons of Jupiter, Saturn etc. The sky is the limit for these
daily new discoveries.
7. QUR'AN INSISTS ALONENESS OF THE CREATOR

chapters.heading: Section 4
paragraphs: The Qur'an starts Chapter 1 – Al Fateha : Ayat 1 by insisting :
"Praise be to Allah, the Rub (Sustainer Lord) of the Universe".
Allah is the Lord of all creation without any distinction of caste, colour,
creed, religion whether they be living or even inanimate objects like the
sun, moon, stars etc. Whether anyone accepts Allah as the Sole Creator
of the universe or not makes no difference to His Glory. The Creator gives
honour to whom He pleases and allows those who disobey to suffer
disgrace over here as well as in the Hereafter. In reality His is the Sole
Power Who does any and every thing that pleases Him.
AH ! WHAT WILL CONVEY TO YOU WHAT IS LAILATUL QADAR ?
Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
8. ALLAH'S GIFT OF WISDOM IS A GREAT BLESSING
Sura 2 – Al Baqarah : Ayat 269 confirms :
"He (Allah) grants wisdom to whom He pleases. And whoever is given
this wisdom (which enables one to know what others do not know),
such indeed have been blessed a great gift. And (very sorry to say)
none pay heed to it except people with understanding".
9. ALLAH IS FRIEND OF BELIEVERS – BRINGS THEM TO HIS LIGHT
Sura 2 – Al Baqarah : Ayat 257 informs :
"Allah is the Friend of those who believe. He brings them out of
darkness into (His) light (of guidance)..."
10. THE FRIENDS OF ALLAH – THEIR POSITION
Sura 4 – An Nisa : Ayat 69 teaches :
"And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, they are indeed with
those upon whom Allah has blessed His favours. They are from
amongst Nabi-een (prophets) and siddiqeen (the truthfuls) and
AH ! WHAT WILL CONVEY TO YOU WHAT IS LAILATUL QADAR ?
Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
shuhada (the martyrs) and saleheen (the doers of good deeds).
Indeed they are the rafiqs or best friends (of Allah)".
Their lives are based upon Sura 10 – Yunus : Ayats 63 – 65 which
informs :
a. 63 – "Without doubt the "Auli - Allah" i.e. the friends of Allah are
such for whom there is no fear, nor do they grieve.
a. 64 – "They are those who believe (in the Aloneness of Allah and
the teachings of His Prophet) and observe "Taqwa" (i.e. their love for
Allah is so firm and unshakable that no temptations on earth can
induce them to sin).
a. 65 – "For them is only good news during their lives on earth and
also in the Hereafter. Allah's promises never change. Without doubt
that is the Supreme Triumph".
Hadis No. 509, Vol. 8, Sahih Al Bukhari records the following teachings
of the Holy Prophet based upon the above revelations of Allah in the
Qur'an :
"Abu Huraira informed : The Messenger of Allah (peace be on him)
taught :
"Allah has said I will declare war upon those who show the least
disrespect to any pious worshipper of Mine. And the most beloved things
by which My slave draws near to Me is by observing 'Taqwa' i.e. His love

Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
for Me to be so firm that no amount of temptations on earth could make
him to deliberately commit a sin, and he keeps on coming closer and
nearer to Me through his 'Zikr' of Me i.e. lost in remembrance of Me till I
fall in love with him and he becomes my 'Wali' i.e. friend. Then I become
his eyes and he sees by Me, and I become his ears and he hears by Me,
and I become his hands and he acts by Me, and I become his legs and he
walks by Me and if he asks anything from Me, with pleasure I grant him
all that he pleads for and I look after him".
11. ALLAH SELECTS FRIENDS AND MAKES THEM LIVING EVEN AFTER DEATH
Sura 3 – Al Imran : Ayat 27 revealed at Madinah states :
"You (Allah) causes the night to pass into day and the day into
night. And You select (Your friends and make them) the living from
the dead (i.e. those in their graves). And You bring forth the dead
from amongst the living (on earth). And You give sustenance to
whom you choose without limit".
In this manner Allah gives life to his friends - the prophets and the saints
after being laid to rest in their graves. He also gives them sustenance
without any limit. As such they can distribute the same also without any
limits to those who come to them asking them to obtain favours from
Allah.

paragraphs: Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
12. ALLAH GIVES UNLIMITED KNOWLEDGE TO WHOM HE PLEASES
Here are brief details of "Ilm-e-gaib" revealed by Allah and blessed upon a
saint. Thus making it clear that He has every right to bless upon
anybody whatever information He likes. None can challenge Allah. A
great prophet asked a saint to reveal some Ilm-e-gaib blessed upon him.
He replied, "You do not have patience to wait for the explanation for the
deeds I do". The prophet concerned assured he would be patient. On that
agreement they boarded a sailing ship. Midway the saint damaged the
boat. The prophet scolded : "Are you trying to drown us?" Next they went
to the house of a pious family who treated them well. The saint killed
their only son. The prophet lost his temper at this unjustified murder.
Then they went to a town for shelter during the night. Wicked people
threw them out at Sunset and closed the city gates on their faces. At
midnight, after the city guards had gone to sleep, the saint built up the
dilapidated wall of a house outside the city. Prophet Moosa (English :
Moses) could not bear up with Khwaja Khizar (peace be upon them ) for
this favour to the wicked town people. Thereupon the saint revealed the
orders of Allah, in respect to the above mentioned three incidents :
a. Two rulers of the area were soon to have a naval battle. All good ships
would be seized. The pious boatmen would lose the means of
existence and die of starvation. He acted under orders of Allah to save
them by making the ship look unseaworthy.
b. The son of the noble family when he grew up in 15 years would
disgrace his parents very badly. As only one son was allotted by Allah
AH ! WHAT WILL CONVEY TO YOU WHAT IS LAILATUL QADAR ?
Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
to this family, the killing of the wicked boy would be replaced by a
noble good heir and give happiness to the pious parents.
c. There was a treasure hidden under the wall. It belonged to orphan
sons of the owner, who after twenty years would be able to take
charge of their house and stay outside the city after 20 years and
discover the treasure and do a lot of good with it to the poor.
Greater details are in Sura 18 – Al Kahf : Ayats 61-83. This brings out
that Allah's gift of wisdom is a great boon and cannot be challenged by
anybody - not even by such a great prophet as Moosa (Moses).
13. A SAINT REVEALS TONIGHT IS LAILATUL QADAR
The first experience of what is Lailatul Qadar to the author of this article
was in 1940 A.D. His uncle Hajee Ebrahim Sidick Jamall phoned up to
his mother and told her :
"Sister, there is a buzurg (saint) staying on the ground floor of my
building, Court De La Range in Lower Range, Calcutta. He has disclosed
that tonight, the 23rd of Ramadan, will be the night of Lailatul Qadar".
Accordingly, after Taraveeh Prayers that night at Tippu Sultan Masjid on
Dharamtolla Street, which is the third largest mosque in Calcutta this
announcement was made by the author. People surrounded him and
sent for the Imam. After hearing the author the Imam said : "Tonight is
23rd of Ramadan. It is one of the “taak” odd nights or the night for
search of Lailatul Qadar. It is also the night between Thursday and

Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
Friday. Saints have Ilm-e-gaib blessed upon them. The most wonderful
example in the Qur'an is to be found in Sura Kahf proving that the Ilm-e-
gaib of Khwaja Khizar was far greater than the knowledge with Prophet
Moosa (peace be upon them). Ilm-e-gaib cannot be challenged".
14. THE BLIND FAITH OF ABU BAKR WINS TITLE OF "AS SIDDIQ"
Then the Imam quoted the example of the event that took place on the
morning of Meraj. Hadrat Abu Bakr returned to Makkah with his
successful trading caravan. Whilst he was offering his prayers of
thanksgiving to Allah at Kaabah, Abu Jahl and other leaders of Qureysh
gathered. When Abu Bakr finished praying, Abu Jahl questioned very
politely : O Abu Bakr how long will it take you on the fastest camel to go
to Jerusalem and return. Abu Bakr gave his calculations of the number
of days it would take. Then they enquired if someone was to say that he
did this journey from Makkah to Jerusalem and came back to Makkah in
one single night would you accept it? Abu Bakr replied : it was quite

chapters.heading: Section 6
paragraphs: impossible. Having trapped Abu Bakr into this admission they tauntingly
informed him that his Prophet has claimed this impossibility today in the
morning. Don't you admit it is a lie? Abu Bakr questioned Abu Jahl :
"Are you speaking the truth that Muhammad (peace be on him) has said
so?" Abu Jahl swore by his gods and confirmed that he had spoken
nothing but the truth. This was confirmed also by the other leaders of
Qureysh. Thereupon Abu Bakr replied :

Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
"I give evidence that without any doubt the Holy Prophet Muhammad
(peace be upon him) has in one night journeyed to Jerusalem and has
returned back to Makkah."
The Imam said that for this "Aamanna Sadakna" or blind faith in the
Holy Prophet and Islam Abu Bakr was awarded the title of "As Siddiq".
Every Muslim must keep such incidents as their examples all the time
before them when questioning or challenging any one on religious
matters.
15. QUR'AN FORBIDS SUSPICION – IMAM ACCEPTS SAINT'S DISCLOSURE
This emphatic answer of Abu Bakr was quite beyond the disbeliever's
comprehension. It shocked all the Makkan leaders. It left them
dumbfounded. This spontaneous response was not based upon any kind
of proofs or logic but only upon pure faith or Iman. In this manner
Hadrat Abu Bakr, the first Khulifa-e-Rashideen has set a wonderful
example for Muslims that they must accept the words of holy people
without any question.
After this example the Imam to support his belief mentioned that the
Qur'an is very specific in Sura 49 – Al Hujurat : Ayat 12 which starts
with :
"O You who believe, shun suspicion the most. Without doubt
suspicion is a crime..."
AH ! WHAT WILL CONVEY TO YOU WHAT IS LAILATUL QADAR ?
Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
The Imam then said : "In view of the above without any further evidence
being necessary I do hereby accept this statement that tonight is
definitely Lailatul Qadar when a holy person has said it is so. I accept
such things without any "Dalil" or evidence. I recommend 11 of you to
observe this night with me as Lailatul Qadar and to search for its
grandeur". Then he thanked me from his heart for having revealed this
vital information for the benefit of Muslims. Then the Imam said :
"Information gained from a short period of contact with a saintly person
can bring benefits as would be equal to a hundred years of continuous
worship of Allah. If we are successful in meeting Lailatul Qadar tonight
then in me night we shall get 1000 months' benefit of worship". He then
quoted the following from the famous Persian Sufi Poet and Saint Shaikh
Saadi Shirazee :
"Ek Saaut Sauhbat-e-Ba Auliya
Behtar Az Sadahaa Ebadut bey Reya".
Translation
“One short period in the company of an auliya (friend of Allah),
Is better than hundreds of times of constant worship of Allah".
Every one present at Tippu Sultan Masjid that night very happily
accepted this without any further proof or checking being necessary.
Thus they showed their Amanna Sadakna without seeking any dalil i.e.
proofs. They all resolved to pray the whole night in search of Lailatul
Qadar. Many of them were successful. It changed their future lives to a
better standard, of doing everything out of love for Allah.
AH ! WHAT WILL CONVEY TO YOU WHAT IS LAILATUL QADAR ?
Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
16. THE EXPERIENCE OF LAILATUL QADAR
Upon returning home to No. 8, Kyd Street, Calcutta 700 016 and having
rested till midnight, the author got up refreshed to perform 100 rakats of
Nifil or optional worship. At 2.54 a.m. Calcutta time, which is equivalent
to 2.30 a.m. Indian Standard time, I witnessed a flash of a bright white
light of unimaginable brilliance, which lit up the western Sky i.e. in the
direction of the Kaabah at Makkah. It was immediately followed by
millions of drops of shinning light pouring like heavy rain from the
heavens. This display of the Light of Allah was so wonderful that it
caused an indescribable thrill of joy, contentment and peace all over my
body. I stood transfixed with amazement.
Such actual experience makes one to realise what is the meaning of Sura
97 – Al Qadar Ayats 1-3 :
"Without doubt We (Allah) revealed it (Qur'an) during Lailatul Qadar
(the Night of Allah's Power to Holy Prophet Muhammad at Gar-e-
Hera or the Cave of Research).
"Ah! What can convey to you (who have not had the good fortune of
meeting) what is Lailatul Qadar?
"(Those who have had the pleasure of seeing the grandeur of)

chapters.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: Lailatul Qadar (know it) is better than a thousand months (of
continuous worship of Allah)."
AH ! WHAT WILL CONVEY TO YOU WHAT IS LAILATUL QADAR ?
Authored by: Hajee Mahboob Kassim
Upon recovering my senses I found that the lighted drops of rain of the
"Noor of Allah" kept on pouring from Heaven for at least three and a half
hours during that night. It brings out the meaning of Sura 24 – An Noor :
Ayat 35 :
"Allah is the Noor (or Light) of the Heavens and the earth ..."
Over here it would be appropriate to quote a short poetry on "Allah"
written by the German Poet Seigfried August Mahlmann (b 1771-d 1816)
which was translated into English by Henry William Longfellow :
ALLAH
"Allah gives light in darkness
"Allah gives relief in pain
"Cheeks that are white with weeping
"Allah paints red again".
"The flowers and the blossoms wither
"Years vanish with flying feet
"But pure hearts live on forever
"Which on earth in sadness beat".
"Gladly to Allah's dwelling
"Yonder would I take flight

"Ya Allah if I worship
You out of fear of Hell
Then into Hell You cast me"
"Ya Allah if I worship
You out of desire of Heaven
Then withhold Heaven from me"
"But Ya Allah if I worship
